subject: UK VAT onboarding: VRN, invoice splitting and PO handoff
messages:
From: Helen Shaw <helen.shaw@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: VATOps <vat-ops@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor onboarding - tax docs and PO alignment

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To keep procurement moving on our side, we attached our current UK VAT registration certificate and a sample invoice for the type of managed logistics services we bill Redwood for. Quick notes/questions: 

- Our VAT registration (VRN) is GB987654321. Certificate attached (Norbit_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf).
- We typically include a single invoice per PO and show VAT as a separate line item. For some US customers we have previously split invoice lines when there are multiple remit addresses — is that something Redwood needs?
- Do you require our company UTR as well or just the VRN?
- Please confirm the exact PO fields we should populate so the accounting system matches (Bill-to name, Redwood PO number field, remit-to address, tax id field).

We want to avoid delays at invoice receipt. If you can confirm the PO format and whether Redwood will accept VAT-charged invoices (or if reverse charge will apply), we can finalize setup today.

Best,
Helen Shaw
Finance Operations
Norbit Logistics
helen.shaw@norbitlogistics.co.uk
+44 20 7123 4456

Attachments: Norbit_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf (pdf, 82KB), Norbit_Sample_Invoice_2026.csv (csv, 3KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Shaw <helen.shaw@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - tax docs and PO alignment

Hi Helen — thanks for sending the docs. Looping in Monica (Procurement/Accounts Payable) and Markus (EMEA Finance) so we can align on the PO/invoice mapping and VAT handling.

High-level from our side:
- VRN (GB number) is what we need to validate vendor VAT registration. UTR is not typically required for invoice processing, but we can request it if EMEA Finance needs it for tax audits.
- For PO mapping, please ensure these fields are present on every invoice: Redwood PO number (exact match), invoice date, invoice number, Bill To: Redwood Inference, remit-to address (company remit address), VAT/Tax ID field (labelled VAT Reg No or VRN).
- Invoice splitting: Redwood prefers a single invoice per PO. If you must split (multiple remit entities), please include line-level PO reference on each split invoice and attach a short explanation.
- VAT treatment: If Redwood is receiving a service and does not have a UK VAT registration, vendor should charge VAT. If Redwood provides a valid UK VAT number and the supply is B2B within the UK, reverse-charge may apply. Markus — can you confirm the guidance for UK services and whether Redwood needs to register or provide any evidence?

Next steps:
1) Monica to confirm final PO field set and upload a PO template.
2) Norbit confirms invoice format and whether you will add the VRN label exactly as 'VAT Reg No'.
3) Once files are aligned we will create vendor record and issue first PO (PO-INT-20261019).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Helen Shaw <helen.shaw@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: VATOps <vat-ops@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - tax docs and PO alignment

Thanks Karthik — confirmed details below and attached the sample invoice CSV for mapping.

- VRN: GB987654321 (we will label the field on invoices as "VAT Reg No: GB987654321").
- We do not have a UK-based Redwood VAT number so we will charge VAT on invoices for services delivered in the UK.
- We can mark invoices with an additional reference field called "PO Line Ref" if you need split-line traceability.

Attached are the two files you requested. Let us know if you want the invoice format adjusted (column headers) before we submit the first invoice.

Best,
Helen

Attachments: Norbit_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf, Norbit_Sample_Invoice_2026.csv

From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, Helen Shaw <helen.shaw@norbitlogistics.co.uk>
Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - tax docs and PO alignment

Hi all — thanks for the attachments, Helen. Quick confirmation from Procurement/Accounts Payable (EMEA):

- VRN provided is sufficient for vendor validation; we have saved Norbit_VAT_Certificate_2026.pdf to our secure vendor folder (link above).
- PO requirements (final):
  * Field: Redwood PO Number (required, exact match)
  * Field: VAT Reg No (please present as 'VAT Reg No: GB987654321')
  * Field: Remit-To Name and Remit-To Address (company remit entity)
  * Optional: PO Line Ref (useful if splitting invoices)

- VAT treatment: Because Redwood does not have a UK VAT registration, Norbit should charge VAT on services invoiced for UK-supplied services. If any line is a cross-border service outside the UK, mark that line and provide supporting detail and we will evaluate VAT treatment case-by-case. For any invoices where you believe reverse-charge should apply, include the buyer VAT number and a clear "reverse charge" statement on the invoice and attach evidence of the buyer VAT registration.

- Invoice processing: We will create the vendor record and issue PO-INT-20261019 by end of day once you confirm the CSV column headers match our template. If you choose to split invoices across remit entities, please include a short note on the invoice indicating why the split was necessary.

If you upload the signed certificate and CSV to the Drive folder and confirm back here we will proceed.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

Office: +1 415 555 0199
